title: Collections Desk Reference: Acceptance Terms and Account Effects of Payment Arrangements
content:
**Collections desk reference card — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**

Acceptance window and methods, and the effect an agreement has on the service account's collection status, by tier.

| Tier | Acceptance window after the offer | Accepted by | Disconnection for the arranged amount held while active and current | Acceptance qualifies a disconnected account for reconnection | Acceptance clears an outstanding disconnect notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 3 calendar days | recorded phone consent, electronic signature, signed paper | yes | yes | yes |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | 5 calendar days | recorded phone consent, electronic signature, signed paper | yes | yes | yes |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | 5 calendar days | recorded phone consent, electronic signature, signed paper | yes | yes | yes |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | 5 calendar days | recorded phone consent, electronic signature, signed paper | yes | yes | yes |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | 3 calendar days | recorded phone consent, electronic signature, signed paper | yes | yes | yes |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | 2 calendar days | electronic signature, signed paper | yes | no | yes |

**Card notes**

- *Acceptance window*: the number of calendar days after the offer within which the member must accept and the down payment must post.
- *Accepted by*: the methods through which the member may accept the agreement. A Commercial Installment Agreement is not accepted by recorded phone consent.
- *Disconnection hold*: on every tier, disconnection for the arranged amount is held while the agreement is active and current.
- *Reconnection*: on every tier except the Commercial Installment Agreement, acceptance qualifies a disconnected account for reconnection.
- *Notice cleared*: on every tier, acceptance clears an outstanding disconnect notice.

**Desk points**

- The shortest acceptance window on the card is the Commercial Installment Agreement's 2 calendar days; the longest is 5 calendar days, on the Extended Hardship, Winter Protection and Medical Certificate tiers.
- A member accepting a Standard Deferred Payment Agreement on the recorded line uses recorded phone consent; the same method is not available to a member accepting a Commercial Installment Agreement.
